domain: Historical execution-backed language coverage aggregation over the 2026-10-22 2,075-file, 553,691,039-byte TSV artifact; exact existing coverage semantics

baselines.name: append every P trace row to parsed list
baselines.citation: scripts/language_coverage.py load_runtime_evidence appends one (location, spelling) tuple for each raw P event; bounded streaming count receipt .scratch/release-recovery-20261022/coverage-trace-memory/evidence/p_record_count.json, input 553691039 bytes across 2075 TSV files
baselines.basis: Exact streaming count of raw P events; retained_P_records counts the parsed list entries before downstream set-only consumers

decision_points.name: P-event parsed-record retention
decision_points.current_choice: append every (normalized location, spelling) tuple to parsed

alternatives.choice: retain unique (normalized location, spelling) tuples in a set while preserving raw P event counting and validation
alternatives.analytic_basis: The existing consumer builds spellings_by_position values as sets and loops over parsed twice only to perform set-backed membership/credit operations. A tuple duplicated in parsed therefore has no additional effect on later results. For P=10,836,487 raw P rows and U=210,221 unique normalized location/spelling tuples on the bounded historical artifact, the retained-record change is U-P=-10,626,266. The event counter remains incremented once per input P row before deduplication.
alternatives.reported_effect: Exactly 10,626,266 fewer retained P tuples on the counted artifact; RSS and elapsed-time gain unmeasured

predicted_delta.baseline_ref: streaming P-record count and unique-key receipt p_record_count.json

alternatives.transferability_note: Exact count applies only to the identified historical artifact. It predicts retained tuple count, not bytes, RSS, runtime, completion, or current execution proof. Any source normalization, malformed-input, ambiguity, hash-collision, negative-form or trace-path rule must remain unchanged.
alternatives.unmeasured_precondition: The collector must keep every original validation and raw event-count side effect and only replace duplicate P tuple retention; cache normalized source identities only within one load_runtime_evidence invocation.
alternatives.falsifying_experiment: On bounded real trace subsets compare baseline and candidate covered-name sets, every event count and trace path list exactly, and exercise duplicate P rows, ambiguous spellings at one source position, malformed duplicate rows, serialized hash collisions and negative syntax-error forms. Then the optimized full historical aggregation may run under the task-owned 3 GiB RSS / 180 second stop; any semantic mismatch falsifies the change. RSS or time is measured only if a complete run receipt is produced.
